title: Contact in the Desert appearances, replacing Jim Marrs

tellings.quote: >> Yeah. I was initially invited long ago to replace somebody I think and uh then I was invited to replace Jim Mars who was sick that year

plain: The writer Peter Levenda says he first spoke at Contact in the Desert, a conference on UFOs and related subjects, long ago, when he was invited to stand in for someone else. He tells Michels he was invited again later, around 2017, to replace another speaker, a man named Jim Marrs, who was sick that year. Levenda gives this as part of his own history with the conference.
